title: Which settings survive the mask?
hook: Five on/off settings live in one number. How do you read just two of them?

knows: AND, OR and XOR on single bits
doesNotKnow: that a mask applies AND, OR or XOR to every bit of a number at once

misconception: To check which of five settings are on you need five separate tests.
objective: The learner can compute 10110 AND 00110 = 00110 and explain that one mask reads (AND), sets (OR) or flips (XOR) chosen bits all at once.

claims.text: 10110 AND 00110 gives 00110: only the places the mask marks keep their setting, and the 1 at the far left is dropped.
claims.source: Bitwise AND place by place. Node: (0b10110 & 0b00110).toString(2) = '110' = 00110. Demo.tsx START_RESULT. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Node: 0b10110 & 0b00110 = 00110.

claims.text: AND gives 1 only where both are 1; OR gives 1 where either is 1; XOR gives 1 where they differ.
claims.source: Truth tables of AND, OR, exclusive OR (e.g. Harris and Harris, Digital Design and Computer Architecture, 1.5). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Re-derived; no issue.

claims.text: OR with a mask turns every marked place on, and XOR with a mask flips every marked place; unmarked places keep their setting.
claims.source: x OR 1 = 1, x OR 0 = x; x XOR 1 = not x, x XOR 0 = x. Stage QA path: 10110 OR 11001 = 11111, 10110 XOR 11001 = 01111 (Node check). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Node: 10110 OR 11001 = 11111; XOR = 01111.

claims.text: One mask works on all five places in one step.
claims.source: Bitwise operators act on every bit of a machine word in a single instruction (Kernighan and Ritchie, The C Programming Language, 2nd ed., 2.9 Bitwise Operators). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Re-derived; no issue.

claims.text: File permissions on Unix are stored and changed this way.
claims.source: chmod(1) and chmod(2) man pages: permission bits form a mode word (e.g. 0755) combined with bit masks; POSIX sys/stat.h defines S_IRUSR, S_IWUSR etc. as mask constants. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-13 (pass 6): Unix mode bits are masked with chmod/umask; correct.

recall.question: Settings are 0101. Which mask and operation switch the leftmost setting on without touching the others?
recall.why: OR with a 1 turns that place on; OR with 0 leaves the other places as they were.
